title: Alarm Arm and Disarm Audit
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alarm:event (action=arm OR action=disarm)
| stats count as events, values(action) as actions by user _time
| sort - _time
| head 50
description: Keeps a log of who armed or disarmed the alarm and when, a simple audit trail for a busy household.
value: An arm and disarm history answers the everyday question of whether the house was actually set, and by whom, without guesswork.
implementation: Ingest alarm-panel events to `index=personal`; review the recent arm and disarm history by user.
visualization: Table of recent arm and disarm actions by user and time.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a record of who turned the burglar alarm on or off and when, so you can always check.
